variants.text: Nine buildings at the foot of the vent fields, and the ground under them is warm to the hand in every month.
Slagfoot. They boil water by standing the pot on the floor and they are not being funny.
Sulphur in the air, faint, all the time, and you stop smelling it and then you notice you have stopped.
Somebody is watching the vents. Somebody is always watching the vents.
